purpose: Construct the Reference-only numerical self-disagreement calibration surface for the thirty F-ROSS13 extension materials before any new extension-material RossFast discrepancy is generated or inspected.

matrix.case_order: material major, then effective_saturation, then forcing

method.comparison: one Reference solve over 0.0064 day versus two sequential Reference solves over 0.0032 + 0.0032 day
method.threshold_rule_for_next_freeze: For each metric and exact Se stratum, use the empirical maximum over all 60 valid extension-material Reference cases, with factor 1.0 and application floor 0.0.

outcome_policy.if_all_180_reference_pairs_valid: Persist full dataset and Se-stratified empirical maxima for independent P2E12 threshold freeze.
outcome_policy.if_any_reference_pair_invalid: Retain every failure classification. Do not execute extension-material RossFast. Adjudicate whether a complete candidate-independent calibration domain exists.

nonclaims: No RossFast extension-material scientific admissibility result is generated by P2E11.
No threshold is widened from P2E10 observations.
No claim extends beyond the exact E0 geometry, state and forcing design.
